title: A generic first-or-default method returns the stored item or the supplied default

ground_truth.statement: A generic first-or-default method returns the stored item or the supplied default. An omitted default permits null; a string default must remain a possible string result.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. The reduced criterion retains the generic first-or-default result and non-null default alternative; proprietary argless-call assertion parsing is not claimed. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
